findings.finding: The answer says standard support access includes an engineering team outside the EU/EEA, while EU/EEA-only access is only a paid option. It does not commit to including that option, so the stated approach does not meet the shall-requirement.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether EU/EEA-only support access will be included and explicitly state the commitment; otherwise identify the deviation.

findings.finding: The answer says 99.95% availability is available under a premium SLA at extra cost but does not commit to providing that SLA for the services in scope.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether the premium SLA will be included and explicitly state the committed availability.

findings.finding: The stated maintenance window is 00:00–04:00, not the required 01:00–05:00, and the answer leaves commitment to the required window for later confirmation.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether the required window can be committed to and state the committed window; otherwise identify the deviation.

findings.finding: Norwegian-speaking support is only available on weekdays from 08:00 to 16:00, and the answer does not commit to Norwegian support 24/7 for critical incidents.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether Norwegian-language support will be available 24/7 for critical incidents and explicitly state the commitment; otherwise identify the deviation.
